# Approved Desktop Baselines

These owner-approved snapshots and CSS patches are immutable test inputs, not maintained demo projects. Their original contents, including language, manifests and license notices, remain byte-for-byte unchanged. `manifest.json` records the hashes captured before the directory migration.

The maintained preview lives in [verification/desktop-demo](../../../verification/desktop-demo/README.md). Tests compare it and the desktop renderer against the approved assets; a failing comparison is not permission to rewrite a baseline.

The approved snapshots came from `.scratch/desktop-shadcn/`; `ui-demo.html` came from `.scratch/desktop-gui/`, at pre-migration commit `155ba39f85ce25a3fcd230f6459d18ef2f910c7c`. Historical relative links inside the frozen files refer to that original tree. Work tracking now uses [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/num-lab/Ruukoto/issues).
